text_blocks.snippet: Cancer caregivers frequently experience significant stress and burden due to the emotional, physical, and financial demands of caring for a loved one with cancer. This stress can manifest in various ways, including emotional distress, physical symptoms, and even caregiver burnout. Recognizing the signs of stress and seeking support are crucial for caregivers to maintain their well-being and continue providing effective care.

list.title: Physical symptoms:
